artworks.title: Philip II, King of Spain
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper torso of a man facing forward. He has a beard and mustache, wearing a hat with vertical folds. He has a calm expression, wearing a garment with a ruffled collar and a medallion on a cord around his neck. The background includes lions on either side of the oval frame and decorative text around the border. The image is in black and white, with detailed engraving lines.

artworks.title: Philip II, King of Spain
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.2 x 13.5 cm (7 3/16 x 5 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a composed manner. The person is facing forward with one hand resting on a helmet placed on a pedestal to their side, while the other hand is holding a baton. The individual has a beard and curly hair. They are dressed in an elaborate suit of armor, with distinctive patterns and embellishments, including a ruffled collar and layered plates typical of historical military attire. At their feet, there is a tiled floor extending into a scenic backdrop with sailing ships on the sea and a distant view of mountainous landscapes. The pedestal next to the person bears a coat of arms featuring complex heraldic symbols.

artworks.title: Philip II, King of Spain
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a bust portrait of a man visible from the chest up, facing slightly to the right. He has a long mustache and a hat covering most of his short hair. He wears a high-collared garment with a ruffled lace collar, a coat with fur-trimmed shoulders, and a chain with a cross pendant. The oval portrait is surrounded by an engraved border with text identifying him as Philippus II. The background features a hatching technique typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed engraving of a man's head and upper torso. The man is facing slightly to his left and has identifiable features such as a strong chin, a neatly trimmed mustache, and short wavy hair. He has a solemn expression, gazing directly ahead. He is wearing ornate armor with an elaborate ruff collar, typical of the fashion of the time, adorned with a chain across his chest. The engraving includes intricate patterns and textures on the armor. The man is surrounded by an oval frame with floral and fruit motifs. A ribbon with inscribed text is above the frame, and the background features intricate hatching and linework, enhancing the overall ornate appearance of the engraving.

artworks.title: Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a distinctive mustache, wearing a lace ruff collar and a patterned garment. The man's face is in a slight three-quarter view, looking to the right. The background has a hatched pattern and an oval frame with an inscription around the portrait. Below the portrait, there is a Latin inscription on a plain section of the paper.

artworks.title: Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.description: There is an engraved portrait of a man with distinctive facial features, wearing ornate armor and a ruff around his neck. The background includes an oval frame with Latin inscriptions, two medallions, and the words "SPES FVTVRI" and the engraver's name, "Lucas Kilianus."

artworks.title: Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, positioned at the center and facing slightly to the left. He has strong facial features with a neatly trimmed mustache and a pointed beard. His hair is styled back or naturally falls that way. He is wearing a highly detailed, ornate garment, likely a form of armor, with intricate patterns and embellishments visible on the shoulder and chest areas, along with a large, prominent ruffled collar. The man is encircled by a decorative oval frame inscribed with text. He is not visibly holding any objects or wearing jewelry. The background is detailed with engraved patterns. Below the man, within an elaborately designed section, the words "SPES FUTVRI" are engraved, flanked by decorative symbols.

artworks.title: Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man in a bust portrait, facing slightly to his left. He has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, with short, combed-back hair. He wears a garment with a ruffled collar and fur-trimmed cloak. The background has an oval frame with text and decorative line patterns. The engraving includes inscriptions in Latin and French.

artworks.title: Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a man named Philippus IIII, Anno 1601. He is upright, facing forward, with his body slightly turned. His facial features include a strong gaze, high cheekbones, and a mustache. His hair is short and styled close to the scalp. The man wears intricately designed armor with ornate detailing and a large ruff collar. Above him, there is decorative fabric with detailed folds. The background is textured within the oval frame. French text at the bottom adds historical context.

artworks.title: Philip IV of Spain
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a person facing forward but slightly angled to their right. The individual has fine facial features, with a youthful appearance, short hair combed back, and prominent cheekbones. They are dressed in an elaborate costume typical of nobility, with a large ruff collar, ornate garment, semi-circular embellishments, a sash, and a decorative chain with medallions. The background is a crosshatched dark field encircled by a border with text.

artworks.title: Philip IV, King of Spain
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a young boy facing slightly to the viewer's right. He has short, light-colored hair, delicate features, and a focused expression. He is wearing an elaborate outfit with a large ruffled collar, detailed embroidery, and a richly decorated cloak with intricate patterns and metallic threadwork. He wears decorative adornments across his shoulders. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with Latin inscriptions indicating his identity as Philippus IV. At the bottom of the frame is a shield with heraldic symbols and Latin text. The background consists of densely engraved lines.

artworks.title: Philip of Cleves and Julich
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man with distinct facial features, including a pointed beard and mustache. He is looking directly at the viewer, slightly turned to his right. His hair is neatly styled, swept back from his forehead, with some volume. He wears a detailed, patterned garment with a high fur-lined collar and a large chain with visible links. The background features intricate engravings framing the oval portrait, with Latin inscriptions and heraldic symbols, including lions.

artworks.title: Philip, Duc d'Orléans, Brother of Louis XIV
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a horse in a regal pose. The individual has wavy hair, distinct facial features, and wears ornate armor with a cape. The horse is well-groomed with decorative bows. The rider holds a baton. Above, a cherubic figure holds a shield with fleur-de-lis symbols. The background displays a pastoral landscape with smaller figures and a castle in the distance.

artworks.title: Philip Louis, Count Palatine
artworks.description: This image is an illustrated portrait of a man shown from the chest up, positioned in the center facing slightly to his right. He has a stern expression with a slightly furrowed brow, mustache, and beard, and his hair is short and appears neatly styled. The man is dressed in a traditional garment with a fur collar and an elaborate ruffled collar typical of noble attire from the Renaissance or Baroque period. Surrounding the man is an ornate oval frame, embellished with floral elements and inscriptions in Latin. Above the frame, two allegorical figures are situated on either side: one holding scales and a sword and another with a cornucopia. The lower portion of the image displays a larger decorative base with Latin text and features a resting lion. The entire image is highly detailed, crafted to resemble an engraved portrait, with monochromatic shading and intricate line work contributing to a sense of depth and richness.

artworks.title: Philip William, Prince of Nassau
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright in a regal pose. He has a styled beard and mustache, neatly combed back hair, and is dressed in an elaborate outfit with a ruff collar, doublet, breeches, a hat with a feather, and a sword. He wears a cloak and a belt, and visible shoes. The background includes a decorated interior, a piece of furniture, a coat of arms, and a maritime scene. The image is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Philip William, Prince of Nassau
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on an ornate chair. He is facing forward with one hand on his chest and the other holding a sword on his knee. The man has a mustache, a pointed beard, and styled hair. He is wearing elaborate clothing with a large collar, a doublet with puffed shoulders, a short tunic, hose, and pointed shoes. A coat of arms is above him. There is a hat on a table nearby. The chair has intricate carvings and the background has a patterned backdrop with a window showing a castle and hills. The image is enclosed in a decorated border.

artworks.title: Philip William, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a man shown from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to the viewer's right with his head facing forward. He has a prominent mustache and neatly combed hair. The man is wearing elaborate armor with ornate detailing, particularly on the shoulder and chest plate. He wears a large ruff around his neck. To his left, there is an elegant coat of arms. The background includes a brick wall, a column on the right, and a distant landscape with trees and water or a city skyline on the horizon.

artworks.title: Philip William, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, posing with one hand on his hip and the other holding a sword by its hilt. His facial features include a mustache and groomed hair, with a stern expression. He is wearing armor with ornate patterns, and a lace ruff encircles his neck. Behind him, a helmet with a plume rests on a surface, and a curtain is drawn to the side, revealing part of a column in the background.

artworks.title: Francisco Pizarro
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a neutral expression facing towards his right. He has a beard, mustache, and curly hair, and is wearing a cap with a brooch. He is dressed in a robe with elaborate designs and wears a pearl necklace. Two feather plumes are in the background. Latin inscriptions and decorative elements surround the portrait, which is in a classical style.

artworks.title: Pocahontas
artworks.description: The image consists of a bust-length portrait of a person within an oval frame. The individual is seated facing forward, with an upright posture and their head slightly tilted to the left. The person has delicate features, dark hair covered by a tall hat, and is dressed in elaborate clothing. They appear to be holding a small bouquet of flowers in one hand, with the other hand resting below. The oval frame surrounding them contains inscriptions. The background is plain with a subtle textured pattern, and there is text below the portrait explaining the individual's background. The paper shows creases, worn edges, and no other objects are present.

artworks.title: Pocahontas
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a seated person's upper body. The person faces forward with a calm expression, prominent eyes, and soft facial features. They have smooth hair peeking out from beneath a tall, rounded hat with feathers. The individual wears an elaborate outfit, including a detailed robe with patterns, a lace-trimmed collar, and a necklace. In the background, there is a textured oval pattern framing the portrait, with inscriptions naming the person as Matoaka alias Rebecca, daughter of Prince Powhatan, and providing additional contextual information.

artworks.title: Cardinal Reginald Pole, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Sebastiano del Piombo
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of Reginaldus Pollus, showing him from the waist up. He is seated in a three-quarters position facing slightly to the right. He has a long, flowing beard and a solemn expression, with his hair hidden under his cardinal's galero. Reginaldus is dressed in rich ecclesiastical garments that drape in heavy folds around his shoulders, adorned with buttons down the front. His left hand rests on his knee, partially covered by his robe. Behind him, there is part of a wooden chair with a spherical finial on the top of the post. In the background, there is a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Johannes Polyander, Doctor of Divinity and Teacher
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: This engraving depicts a man with a mustache and beard, facing slightly to the right in an oval frame. He wears a ruff around his neck, a garment with a fur-trimmed outer layer and a patterned inner layer. The man is labeled as Johannes Polyander. The background features detailed line work, and text at the bottom gives information about the image.
